subject: the grey ash of a burnt-out witchfire: vanilla's powder heap in ash grey
mode: recolour of a vanilla sprite (no generation, no credits)
method: each pixel keeps its lightness (mid-tones lifted by 1.12 plus 6, capped at 235; pixels at or below 60 untouched so the ink line stays dark), hue and saturation removed, blue raised 3 percent; framed with trim_card_art.trim(). Vanilla draws every powder as this same heap in another colour (Documentation/CSFF_Art_Profile.md section 1). This is a recoloured copy of a vanilla sprite shipped inside the mod, as the liquid bowls are.
